'''Corran on the Horn''' is a ''Star Wars'' CCG interview podcast hosted by [[Kendall Halman]] (forum name Corran) on the KendallCast Network.<ref name="rss">[https://rssamplifier.com/corrancast CorranCast], RSS Amplifier (KendallCast Network master feed).</ref> Since January 2022 it has released 44 numbered episodes, the latest in October 2026, published on the KendallCast blog with audio on the Internet Archive and some episodes on YouTube.<ref name="ep1">[https://www.kendallcast.ninja/2022/01/corran-on-horn-1-james-martin.html Corran on the Horn - 1 - James Martin], KendallCast (24 January 2022).</ref><ref name="blog">[https://www.kendallcast.ninja/ KendallCast], kendallcast.ninja (blog posts labelled "Corran on the Horn", January 2022 – October 2026).</ref> Guests include world champions, designers, volunteers and content creators. The network's master feed, CorranCast, also carries ''Top 8 with Corran and Batmouse''.<ref name="rss" />

== Earlier interviews ==
Before the numbered series, Kendall released standalone KendallCast interviews in 2020 and 2021, including a World Championship Interview Series with past world champions for the 25th World Championship.<ref name="sokol">[https://www.kendallcast.ninja/2020/11/the-matt-sokol-interview.html The Matt Sokol Interview], KendallCast (29 November 2020).
